bcgm.title: All Polynomial Generators Preserve Distance with Mutual Correlated Agreement

theorem_pins.subcode_rule: Use S-two for the exact circle FFT subspace and its Johnson correlated-agreement base case. BCGM supplies only the cited code-agnostic transformations and an ambient-RS cross-check; ambient-RS Theorem 9.2 alone is not used to infer the exact circle-subcode theorem.

work_sensitivity.expectation_convention: K is the zero-based minimum successful nonce. E[K]=2^g-1 failures and E[K+1]=2^g predicate hashes/trials, up to negligible finite-u64 conditioning.

bcs.handling: The event union includes a 128-bit SHA/ROM row and the complete union is multiplied by 31. That is more conservative than Theorem 22's normalized collision term at Q_H<=2^128. The profile-20 transcript compiler factor must remain pinned; profile 22 adds no source or other challenge boundary.

nonzero_field_challenges: eta, sampled uniformly from QM31 minus zero with at most three attempts
profile-22 gamma, sampled uniformly from QM31 minus zero with at most three attempts
separate_local_rows: nonzero-gamma batching and copy-inactive rows 29/(Q-1) and 27/(Q-1)
challenge_audit.no_double_count_rule: The eta, nonzero-gamma, mu and equality-point rows are unioned separately; none is hidden inside the 270/Q sumcheck-protocol row.
challenge_audit.nonzero_conditioning_rule: Any full-field polynomial or MCA failure bound for gamma is divided by Pr[gamma!=0]=(Q-1)/Q, which changes the denominator from Q to Q-1 without requiring a new MCA theorem.
challenge_audit.nonzero_sampler_exhaustion: Completeness rejection Q^-3 per eta or gamma challenge, apart from the separately bounded M31 limb sampler exhaustion; never a zero fallback or soundness event.
challenge_audit.ood_rejection: line OOD samples are uniform in QM31 minus CM31; the secure-circle poles plus or minus i already lie in CM31, so the pinned Q-|CM31| denominator remains exact
challenge_audit.denominator_events: LogUp/copy/range denominator roots are covered by 4*(183+1024)/Q; no source or delta denominator exists

johnson_soundness.soundness_status: The selected Johnson numeric theorem uses g38 at both batch and final/query. The profile-22 diagnostic transcript/KAT is pinned; applicability to the final artifact still requires all six work records to be actually mined and checked on the production transcript. Private salting changes only the Merkle binding hybrid, not the polynomial/code events.

computational_rom_epro.model: one domain-separated SHA-256 random oracle with Q_H<=2^128; not the BCS statistical private-Merkle lemma

tree_inventory.frontier_policy: maximal unopened frontier labels are a subset of the booked Merkle-node inputs and are not double-counted

computational_rom_epro.conditional_advantage: eps_priv <= eps_aff + eps_field_prg + eps_salt_prg + A*C*Q_H/2^256 + binom(A*C,2)/2^256 + 6*A*exp(-2^25) + eps_side, where A is the bounded attempt count
computational_rom_epro.rom_prg_terms: eps_field_prg=eps_salt_prg=0 only when both expanders are modeled as domain-separated calls to the same ideal random oracle; a standard-model claim must restore and instantiate both advantages
computational_rom_epro.statistical_private_merkle_reason: 32-byte salts do not instantiate the cited BCS 2*lambda-bit-salt statistical lemma for lambda=256

complete_view.mutation_rule: for a fixed public statement and public account branch, sequence/anchor/nullifier mutation and rent effects are deterministic public functions and add no hidden field value

residual_obligations.eps_aff: The witness-independent canonical Good22 predicate, capped unpublished manager, and exact physical/legal/helper containment replay are implemented, so every emitted schedule is containment-good. A uniform quantitative nonzero-gamma raw/sumcheck success bound remains open; cap 16 is not yet a proved negligible no-proof probability.
residual_obligations.eps_side: The bounded attempt manager and fixed-boundary one-output controller are implemented and tested. Deployment remains responsible for invoking the controller at the witness-independent boundary and suppressing failed roots, proofs, nonces, progress, retry count, error classes, telemetry, and remote-worker traffic. Local hardware, OS scheduling, storage, power, and late-callback leakage remain outside the present claim unless modeled in epsilon_side.
residual_obligations.production_wire: open until one mined profile-22 proof passes the production verifier and atomic mutation path with no diagnostic PoW bypass, return data, or witness-dependent log.
residual_obligations.proof_bytes: the diagnostic-unmined fixture is pinned at 56686 bytes and SHA-256 77736f0ea30ae9e2516537213e7dce386c9be69e3c772e5b50f03c57892136f8 with a gap-free typed inventory; the final mined proof length/SHA remains open because mined nonces can change q16 paths and frontier counts.
residual_obligations.standard_model: no SHA-256 PRG or standard-model zero-knowledge claim is made
residual_obligations.release_policy: OS entropy, durable public-nonce burn, candidate zeroization, and the fixed-boundary controller exist; the wallet integration must still keep failed attempts private and call the controller on time
